tool_calls.name: lookup_account
tool_calls.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, c.signup_date, c.preferred_contact, o.name AS organization, p.name AS plan, p.tier AS plan_tier, p.monthly_price, p.refund_limit FROM customers c LEFT JOIN organizations o ON c.organization_id = o.id LEFT JOIN plans p ON c.plan_id = p.id WHERE c.email = 'maya.chen@northwind.example'
SELECT r.id AS refund_id,r.incident_id,r.amount,
        r.status,r.created_at FROM refunds r JOIN customers c ON c.id=r.customer_id
        WHERE c.email='maya.chen@northwind.example' ORDER BY r.id DESC
